permission_interpretation: Declared grants are inputs to effective access; role membership, owner restrictions, sharing, user record restrictions, field levels, and custom permission logic must also be applied.

value_contract.arithmetic_policy: Use the resolved field precision and operation rounding policy; do not infer a quantity unit from the decimal representation.

precision.resolution: Resolve field precision from explicit metadata, currency settings where applicable, and system numeric defaults before rounding.

value_contract.default_application: Apply when constructing a new record with no supplied value, subject to request, user, parent, and transaction defaults. Do not overwrite an explicit value on an existing record.
value_contract.input_normalization: The ordinary record adapter converts numeric input to an integer, including truncating a fractional numeric value toward zero. Invalid or absent numeric input follows the shared numeric-default policy; a domain operation may reject it earlier.
